title: Reading Smiles: Proxy Bias in Foundation Models for Facial Emotion Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on a subset of the AffectNet dataset manually annotated for teeth visibility to evaluate emotion classification performance shifts between visible and non-visible teeth conditions. The study also uses prompt-based introspection and linear regression to quantify the model's reliance on superficial visual shortcuts (e.g., teeth visibility, eyebrow position) for predicting valence and arousal.
